# Dissent Cafe and Bar

> A live music venue and cafe bar at 181 City Walk, Canberra City (Civic), ACT 2601, between the merry-go-round and Garema Place. Open since November 2024. Gigs are ticketed on Humanitix.

- [What's on](https://www.dissentcafeandbar.com.au/whats-on/): upcoming gigs and open mic nights, each with its own page and ticket link
- [About](https://www.dissentcafeandbar.com.au/about-us/): who Dissent is
- [Play here](https://www.dissentcafeandbar.com.au/play/): booking a gig as a band or musician
- [Find us](https://www.dissentcafeandbar.com.au/get-in-touch/): address, map, email and social links
- [Notes](https://www.dissentcafeandbar.com.au/posts/): writing from Dissent on live music and small venues
- [Gig feed](https://www.dissentcafeandbar.com.au/events/feed.xml): Atom feed of gigs
